citations.assessment: The exact Yerushalmi has Chiyya bar Ba introduce Yudan, the son of Shimon ben Yochai’s daughter, who transmits Shimon’s teaching. All roles are explicit in this occurrence.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: The checked teaching is introduced by Chiyya bar Ba. The Yerushalmi expressly identifies Yudan as the son of Shimon ben Yochai’s daughter.
